title:
A checkpoint represents data in an intermediate state of data being
{@link GenaiCore.Unstructured.Processor}[processed].
Each instance corresponds to a specific source file after it has been processed by a given component (and all
preceeding components). Checkpoints can be saved and used to resume processing
or to observe and debug the state of the data at a specific point in the processing pipeline.
